text: Figure 7.3: Service contract versioning over time The AUTOSAR Adaptive platform supports service contract versioning. The service contract versioning is separated between the design phase and the deployment phase. This means that any service at design level may have its own version number which is mapped to a version number of the used network binding and vice versa. The mapping process is manually done by the service designer or integrator.
